FBI Director Kash Patel Grilled by Senate on Hiring Policies

FBI Director Kash Patel faced sharp questioning from senators during a Judiciary Committee hearing regarding changes to the agency's hiring policies. Senators pressed Patel on the loosening of employment standards, specifically concerning individuals with past involvement in bestiality and prostitution. Patel defended the changes, stating the FBI is 'putting the mission first' and that the agency is reviewing its policies. The hearing also touched upon the handling of Epstein files and Patel's personal travel.
